  PROBLEM: The exit-75 deferral comment and run-summary text say an `ai:clarification` issue needs `/answer` re-posted by hand, but stall recovery re-posts it automatically. The same wording appears in README.md:2762, agents.d/9599-plan-defer-rate-limited-integration-ref.md:2, changelog.d/9599-plan-defer-rate-limited-integration-ref.md:2 and tests/test_workflow_checkout_integration_ref_audit.py:1051.
  WHY: `STALL_RECOVERY_ACTIONS["ai:clarification"]` is `["auto_respond_clarify", "auto_respond_clarify", "escalate_human"]` (scripts/orchestrate_lib.py:1669-1673), and scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:26319-26353 posts `/answer`. Severity disagreement: the reviewers rated it NIT (anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna) and MAJOR (minimax_minimax-m3). Sonnet 5.5 also notes that runtime behavior is correct and the issue is documentation precision only. MAJOR is mapped to high.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- .github/workflows/plan.yml:455-466 (propagated to README.md:2762, agents.d/9599-plan-defer-rate-limited-integration-ref.md:2, changelog.d/9599-plan-defer-rate-limited-integration-ref.md:2, tests/test_workflow_checkout_integration_ref_audit.py:1051) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The wording puts `ai:clarification` in the manual `/answer` bucket, but stall recovery re-posts `/answer` for it (`scripts/orchestrate_lib.py:1669-1673`, `scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:26319-26353`). The test at tests/test_workflow_checkout_integration_ref_audit.py:1051 asserts "post /answer again by hand" and locks the wording in.
  WHY: An operator reading the summary may post `/answer` by hand while stall recovery is about to do it, which duplicates the comment and the dispatch. The docs also do not distinguish the case where `ENABLE_STANDALONE_STALL_RECOVERY=false`.
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: "Record in the PR that you ran [the regression test] both ways" and verify it fails on the reported head and passes with the fix (from the linked issue's Fix constraints section).
  Expected change site: PR Description > Acceptance table, with results for the red-on-base and fixed-head runs of the two red-on-base tests.
  Evidence of absence: The PR Description lists both `tests/test_workflow_checkout_integration_ref_audit.py::test_plan_rate_limited_refusal_defers_without_failing` and `tests/test_workflow_checkout_integration_ref_audit.py::test_plan_setup_steps_skip_on_rate_limited_defer` as `not run`. The earlier editor deferred this gap, but `gh pr edit --body` is in scope.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR | ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM openai_gpt-6-luna ===
- .github/workflows/plan.yml:476 | severity=NIT | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The run summary says an `ai:clarification` issue needs `/answer` posted by hand, even when standalone stall recovery is enabled.
  WHY: `ai:clarification` maps to `auto_respond_clarify` in `scripts/orchestrate_lib.py:1669-1672`, and `scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:26319-26350` posts `/answer` for that action. The summary therefore gives incorrect recovery instructions.
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: "The fix must remove the cause and ship a regression test that reproduces the failing condition: it fails on the reported head and passes with the fix. Record in the PR that you ran it both ways."
  Expected change site: PR Description > Acceptance, with results for the red-on-base and fixed-head runs.
  Evidence of absence: The PR description marks the red-on-base test targets as "not run" and has no record of running the regression test against both the reported head and the fixed head.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR | ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
=== END FINDINGS FROM openai_gpt-6-luna ===
